title: Half-and-half or light cream for cream that must whip

evidence.basis: B3. OD-7 (owner commission 2026-10-08, ENGINEERING only; not culinary validation, not released guidance). Evidence: private/research/substitution-knowledge (2026-10-07). ATK SRC-CM-16#a (at least 30 percent milk fat to whip); KA SRC-CM-19#a; legal ranges 21 CFR 131.180 half-and-half 10.5-<18% (SRC-CM-04#a), 131.155 light cream 18-<30% (SRC-CM-03#a); Canadian light cream (5-6%) is also below 30%. UK single cream is NOT included: its 18% is only a minimum.

text: This catalog doesn't accept half-and-half or light cream in place of cream that has to be whipped: cream needs at least 30 percent fat to hold air, and these have less.
scopeNote: This is about these thinner creams for whipping only. Light whipping cream (30 percent fat or more) isn't covered by this answer.
answer: has too little fat to whip
